# Mission-Critical Plumbing, Drainage, and Environmental Protection {#sec-plumbing-drainage-environmental}

## Water treatment and supply infrastructure: Reverse osmosis (RO) systems, water softeners, chemical feed skids, and potable water booster stations

Data centers utilizing evaporative cooling towers, adiabatic dry coolers, or ultrasonic/steam white-space humidifiers require high-purity water treatment plants to prevent scale deposition and Legionella proliferation [@ashrae2021tc99; @ref22_reliabilityengine_liquid]. Under RICS NRM2 Section 32/33 and CSI Division 22, the MEP-QS quantifies the core plumbing, drainage, and leak-detection systems summarized in @tbl-plumbing-leak-detection-boq:

| Plumbing & Environmental Package | Primary Unit of Measurement | Standard Measurement Rules & Specifications | Critical QS Inclusions & Risk Factors |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Make-Up Water Tanks & RO Skids** | Number (No.) of tanks / skids | Sectional GRP or concrete tanks (24–72 hr peak summer autonomy); multimedia/carbon filters, duplex softeners, and RO membrane skids [@uptime2018tier; @rics2021nrm2]. | Permeate capacity ($\text{m}^3/\text{h}$), UV sterilization, chemical dosing pumps, and reject-brine neutralization [@ashrae2021tc99; @ref37_aecom_meh2024]. |
| **Technical Condensate & Oil Drainage** | Linear Meter (m) + Number (No.) of interceptors | Segregated insulated copper, stainless, or HDPE condensate drains; EN 858 Class 1 coalescing oil-water separators [@bicsi2024002; @rics2021nrm2]. | Waterless mechanical traps for low-humidity halls; automatic closure valves and high-oil BMS alarms on transformer/diesel bunds [@rics2021nrm2; @ref04_helonic]. |
| **Distance-Locating Leak Detection** | Linear Meter (m) of cable + Number (No.) of panels | Conductive polymer sensing rope around CRAHs, CDUs, and drip pans with hold-down clips every $600\text{ mm}$ and master controllers [@ashrae2023liquid; @rics2021nrm2]. | Pinpointing water or PG25 glycol contact within $\pm 1.0\text{ m}$ and mapping Modbus TCP/BACnet alarm coordinates to BMS/DCIM [@ref14_cxplanner]. |
| **Emergency Showers & Eyewash Units** | Number (No.) of assemblies | ANSI Z358.1 tempered-water safety showers and eyewash stations in VRLA battery, chemical, and fuel unloading zones [@nfpa75; @rics2021nrm2]. | Thermostatic tepid-water mixing valves, dedicated floor drains, and flow-switch BMS/security alarm contacts [@nfpa75; @rics2021nrm2]. |

: Mission-Critical Water Treatment, Segregated Drainage, and Leak Detection BOQ Breakdown {#tbl-plumbing-leak-detection-boq}

- **Raw & Make-Up Water Storage Tanks**: Sectional GRP or reinforced concrete concrete-lined tanks sized for **24 to 72 hours of peak summer evaporative cooling autonomy** [@uptime2018tier; @ref37_aecom_meh2024].
- **Duplex Water Softeners & Reverse Osmosis ([RO]{.gls}) Skids (`No.`)**: Multi-media sand filters, activated carbon filters, duplex ion-exchange softeners, high-pressure RO membrane skids ($\text{m}^3/\text{h}$ permeate rating), UV sterilizers, and chemical dosing pumps [@ref22_reliabilityengine_liquid].

## Critical drainage systems: Chilled water leak containment, cooling tower blowdown drains, oily water separators, and fuel trap chambers

Industrial and technical drainage must be strictly segregated from domestic sanitary foul drainage [@rics2021nrm2; @ref04_helonic]:

1. **Technical Equipment Room & White Space Condensate/Leak Drainage**: Insulated copper, stainless steel, or HDPE drainage lines serving CRAH condensate pans, CDU drip pans, and plantroom floor gullies, fitted with waterless mechanical trap seals (to prevent sewer gas entry when traps dry out in low-humidity halls) [@bicsi2024002; @ref04_helonic].
2. **Hydrocarbon Oil-Water Separators (`No.`)**: Class 1 coalescing oil-water interceptors (EN 858) with automatic closure devices and high-oil-level BMS alarms serving outdoor transformer bunds, bulk diesel unloading aprons, and generator yards [@rics2021nrm2; @ref04_helonic].

## Distance-locating leak detection systems: Sensing cables, zonal location modules, alarm panels, and under-floor sensing grids around CDUs and CRACs

In high-density facilities where primary [FWS]{.gls} mains (@sec-central-chilled-water-plants) and secondary [TCS]{.gls} liquid-cooling headers (@sec-liquid-cooling-tcs) traverse technical galleries and white spaces, a single undetected fluid leak can cause catastrophic short circuits [@ashrae2023liquid; @ref14_cxplanner]. The MEP-QS measures **Addressable Distance-Locating Leak Detection Systems** by:

- **Conductive Polymer Sensing Cable (`m`)**: Measured in linear meters along the perimeter of every [CRAH]{.gls} unit, [CDU]{.gls} skid, under-pipe drip tray, perimeter trench, and beneath raised-floor manifolds, plus adhesive hold-down clips every $600\text{ mm}$ and weighted jumper leads [@rics2021nrm2; @ref14_cxplanner].
- **Digital Distance-Locating Master Controllers (`No.`)**: Capable of pinpointing water or PG25 glycol contact to within $\pm 1.0\text{ m}$ along the cable run and communicating exact coordinates to the [BMS]{.gls}/[DCIM]{.gls} (@sec-bms-epms-dcim) via Modbus TCP/BACnet [@ref14_cxplanner].

## Domestic water, emergency eyewash stations, and sanitary installations within technical and administrative zones

Includes tempered water **Emergency Safety Showers and Eyewash Stations** (ANSI Z358.1 compliant, mandatory inside VRLA battery rooms, water-treatment chemical rooms, and diesel unloading bays), complete with tepid-water mixing valves, floor drains, and flow-switch BMS alarm contacts that alert security control rooms immediately upon activation [@rics2021nrm2; @nfpa75].
